questions.query: I consent to participate in this treatment group survey about investment attitudes
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Treatment Group Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study - Treatment Group

Purpose: You have been randomly assigned to the treatment group. This survey examines your attitudes regarding investment decisions for children with different abilities.

What you will do: Answer questions about your investment philosophy and decision-making factors. This should take approximately 5 minutes.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research purposes.

Voluntary Participation: Participation is voluntary. You may withdraw at any time.
This survey examines your attitudes about investing in {child1name} (ability: {child1ability}, attends {child1school}) and {child2name} (ability: {child2ability}, attends {child2school}).
